datasets.name: ds_fill
queryLines:
SELECT col AS field,
  count(*) AS total_rows,
  sum(CASE WHEN val IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(val)) NOT IN ('', 'null', '[]', 'none', 'nan', '{}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN val IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(val)) NOT IN ('', 'null', '[]', 'none', 'nan', '{}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS filled_pct,
  count(DISTINCT val) AS distinct_values,
  sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(val AS double) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric_values,
  sum(CASE WHEN val LIKE '[%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS list_values,
  round(avg(length(val)), 1) AS avg_length,

datasets.name: ds_clean
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT unique_id, name, address_city AS city, address_zipOrPostcode AS postcode,
    CASE initcap(lower(trim(address_stateOrRegion))) WHEN 'Tamilnadu' THEN 'Tamil Nadu' WHEN 'Orissa' THEN 'Odisha' WHEN 'Pondicherry' THEN 'Puducherry' WHEN 'Uttaranchal' THEN 'Uttarakhand' WHEN 'New Delhi' THEN 'Delhi' WHEN 'Jammu & Kashmir' THEN 'Jammu And Kashmir' ELSE initcap(lower(trim(address_stateOrRegion))) END AS state_norm,
    CASE WHEN facilityTypeId IN ('hospital', 'clinic', 'dentist', 'doctor') THEN facilityTypeId WHEN facilityTypeId IN ('pharmacy', 'farmacy') THEN 'pharmacy' ELSE 'unknown' END AS facility_type,
    CASE WHEN operatorTypeId IN ('public', 'government') THEN 'public' WHEN operatorTypeId = 'private' THEN 'private' ELSE 'unknown' END AS operator_type,
    latitude, longitude,
    try_cast(capacity AS double) AS beds,
    try_cast(numberDoctors AS double) AS doctors,
    try_cast(yearEstablished AS int) AS yr,
    from_json(source_ids, 'array<string>') AS src_arr,
    from_json(specialties, 'array<string>') AS spec_arr,
    from_json(procedure, 'array<string>') AS proc_arr,
    from_json(equipment, 'array<string>') AS equip_arr,
    length(description) AS description_length
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities
  WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT unique_id, name, city, state_norm AS state_as_written,
  CASE WHEN state_norm IN ('Andhra Pradesh', 'Arunachal Pradesh', 'Assam', 'Bihar', 'Chhattisgarh', 'Goa', 'Gujarat', 'Haryana', 'Himachal Pradesh', 'Jharkhand', 'Karnataka', 'Kerala', 'Madhya Pradesh', 'Maharashtra', 'Manipur', 'Meghalaya', 'Mizoram', 'Nagaland', 'Odisha', 'Punjab', 'Rajasthan', 'Sikkim', 'Tamil Nadu', 'Telangana', 'Tripura', 'Uttar Pradesh', 'Uttarakhand', 'West Bengal', 'Delhi', 'Chandigarh', 'Puducherry', 'Jammu And Kashmir', 'Ladakh') THEN state_norm ELSE 'Other or not a state' END AS state,
  facility_type, operator_type, latitude, longitude,
  CASE WHEN beds > 0 THEN beds END AS beds,
  CASE WHEN doctors > 0 THEN doctors END AS doctors,
  CASE WHEN beds > 0 THEN 'Has bed count' ELSE 'No bed count' END AS bed_count_recorded,
  CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 1800 AND 2026 THEN yr END AS year_established,
  CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 1950 AND 2026 THEN make_date(yr, 1, 1) END AS established_date,
  CASE WHEN beds IS NULL OR beds <= 0 THEN NULL WHEN beds <= 10 THEN '1) 1-10' WHEN beds <= 25 THEN '2) 11-25' WHEN beds <= 50 THEN '3) 26-50' WHEN beds <= 100 THEN '4) 51-100' WHEN beds <= 250 THEN '5) 101-250' WHEN beds <= 500 THEN '6) 251-500' WHEN beds <= 1000 THEN '7) 501-1,000' WHEN beds <= 5000 THEN '8) 1,001-5,000' ELSE '9) over 5,000' END AS beds_bucket,
  CASE WHEN doctors IS NULL OR doctors <= 0 THEN NULL WHEN doctors = 1 THEN '1) 1' WHEN doctors <= 5 THEN '2) 2-5' WHEN doctors <= 10 THEN '3) 6-10' WHEN doctors <= 25 THEN '4) 11-25' WHEN doctors <= 50 THEN '5) 26-50' WHEN doctors <= 100 THEN '6) 51-100' WHEN doctors <= 500 THEN '7) 101-500' ELSE '8) over 500' END AS doctors_bucket,
  size(src_arr) AS source_count,
  CASE WHEN src_arr IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN size(src_arr) <= 5 THEN '1) 1-5' WHEN size(src_arr) <= 10 THEN '2) 6-10' WHEN size(src_arr) <= 19 THEN '3) 11-19' WHEN size(src_arr) <= 34 THEN '4) 20-34' WHEN size(src_arr) <= 49 THEN '5) 35-49' ELSE '6) 50 (the cap)' END AS source_bucket,
  CASE WHEN spec_arr IS NOT NULL THEN size(filter(spec_arr, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND trim(x) <> '')) END AS n_specialties,
  CASE WHEN proc_arr IS NOT NULL THEN size(filter(proc_arr, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND trim(x) <> '')) END AS n_procedures,
  CASE WHEN equip_arr IS NOT NULL THEN size(filter(equip_arr, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND trim(x) <> '')) END AS n_equipment,
  description_length
FROM base

datasets.name: ds_size
queryLines:
SELECT name, address_city AS city,
  CASE WHEN facilityTypeId IN ('hospital', 'clinic', 'dentist', 'doctor') THEN facilityTypeId ELSE 'other' END AS facility_type,
  try_cast(capacity AS double) AS beds, try_cast(numberDoctors AS double) AS doctors
FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities
WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND try_cast(capacity AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 1500
  AND try_cast(numberDoctors AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 400

datasets.name: ds_suspects
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT unique_id, name, address_city AS city, address_zipOrPostcode AS postcode,
    CASE initcap(lower(trim(address_stateOrRegion))) WHEN 'Tamilnadu' THEN 'Tamil Nadu' WHEN 'Orissa' THEN 'Odisha' WHEN 'Pondicherry' THEN 'Puducherry' WHEN 'Uttaranchal' THEN 'Uttarakhand' WHEN 'New Delhi' THEN 'Delhi' WHEN 'Jammu & Kashmir' THEN 'Jammu And Kashmir' ELSE initcap(lower(trim(address_stateOrRegion))) END AS state_norm,
    CASE WHEN facilityTypeId IN ('hospital', 'clinic', 'dentist', 'doctor') THEN facilityTypeId WHEN facilityTypeId IN ('pharmacy', 'farmacy') THEN 'pharmacy' ELSE 'unknown' END AS facility_type,
    CASE WHEN operatorTypeId IN ('public', 'government') THEN 'public' WHEN operatorTypeId = 'private' THEN 'private' ELSE 'unknown' END AS operator_type,
    latitude, longitude,
    try_cast(capacity AS double) AS beds,
    try_cast(numberDoctors AS double) AS doctors,
    try_cast(yearEstablished AS int) AS yr,
    from_json(source_ids, 'array<string>') AS src_arr,
    from_json(specialties, 'array<string>') AS spec_arr,
    from_json(procedure, 'array<string>') AS proc_arr,
    from_json(equipment, 'array<string>') AS equip_arr,
    length(description) AS description_length
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities
  WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL
),
st AS (
  SELECT state_norm, percentile_approx(latitude, 0.5) AS mlat, percentile_approx(longitude, 0.5) AS mlon
  FROM base WHERE state_norm IN ('Andhra Pradesh', 'Arunachal Pradesh', 'Assam', 'Bihar', 'Chhattisgarh', 'Goa', 'Gujarat', 'Haryana', 'Himachal Pradesh', 'Jharkhand', 'Karnataka', 'Kerala', 'Madhya Pradesh', 'Maharashtra', 'Manipur', 'Meghalaya', 'Mizoram', 'Nagaland', 'Odisha', 'Punjab', 'Rajasthan', 'Sikkim', 'Tamil Nadu', 'Telangana', 'Tripura', 'Uttar Pradesh', 'Uttarakhand', 'West Bengal', 'Delhi', 'Chandigarh', 'Puducherry', 'Jammu And Kashmir', 'Ladakh') GROUP BY state_norm HAVING count(*) >= 30
),
pin AS (
  SELECT pincode, max(CASE initcap(lower(trim(statename))) WHEN 'Orissa' THEN 'Odisha' WHEN 'Pondicherry' THEN 'Puducherry' WHEN 'Jammu & Kashmir' THEN 'Jammu And Kashmir' ELSE initcap(lower(trim(statename))) END) AS pin_state, count(DISTINCT statename) AS n_states
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.india_post_pincode_directory GROUP BY pincode
),
dup AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(name)) AS k_name, lower(trim(city)) AS k_city FROM base WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> 'null' GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT 'Over 2,000 beds' AS reason, name, city, state_norm AS state, facility_type, cast(cast(beds AS bigint) AS string) AS detail FROM base WHERE beds > 2000
UNION ALL SELECT 'Over 500 doctors', name, city, state_norm, facility_type, cast(cast(doctors AS bigint) AS string) FROM base WHERE doctors > 500
UNION ALL SELECT 'Clinic, dentist or doctor with over 200 beds', name, city, state_norm, facility_type, cast(cast(beds AS bigint) AS string) FROM base WHERE facility_type IN ('clinic', 'dentist', 'doctor') AND beds > 200
UNION ALL SELECT 'Year established before 1800 or after 2026', name, city, state_norm, facility_type, cast(yr AS string) FROM base WHERE yr < 1800 OR yr > 2026
UNION ALL SELECT 'Coordinates outside India', name, city, state_norm, facility_type, concat(cast(round(latitude, 2) AS string), ', ', cast(round(longitude, 2) AS string)) FROM base WHERE NOT (latitude BETWEEN 6 AND 37 AND longitude BETWEEN 68 AND 98)
UNION ALL SELECT 'Coordinates far from the stated state', b.name, b.city, b.state_norm, b.facility_type, concat(cast(round(b.latitude, 2) AS string), ', ', cast(round(b.longitude, 2) AS string)) FROM base b JOIN st ON b.state_norm = st.state_norm WHERE (abs(b.latitude - st.mlat) > 4 OR abs(b.longitude - st.mlon) > 4) AND b.latitude BETWEEN 6 AND 37 AND b.longitude BETWEEN 68 AND 98
UNION ALL SELECT 'Postcode belongs to a different state', b.name, b.city, b.state_norm, b.facility_type, concat(b.postcode, ' is in ', pin.pin_state) FROM base b JOIN pin ON try_cast(regexp_replace(b.postcode, '[^0-9]', '') AS bigint) = pin.pincode WHERE pin.n_states = 1 AND b.state_norm IN ('Andhra Pradesh', 'Arunachal Pradesh', 'Assam', 'Bihar', 'Chhattisgarh', 'Goa', 'Gujarat', 'Haryana', 'Himachal Pradesh', 'Jharkhand', 'Karnataka', 'Kerala', 'Madhya Pradesh', 'Maharashtra', 'Manipur', 'Meghalaya', 'Mizoram', 'Nagaland', 'Odisha', 'Punjab', 'Rajasthan', 'Sikkim', 'Tamil Nadu', 'Telangana', 'Tripura', 'Uttar Pradesh', 'Uttarakhand', 'West Bengal', 'Delhi', 'Chandigarh', 'Puducherry', 'Jammu And Kashmir', 'Ladakh') AND pin.pin_state IN ('Andhra Pradesh', 'Arunachal Pradesh', 'Assam', 'Bihar', 'Chhattisgarh', 'Goa', 'Gujarat', 'Haryana', 'Himachal Pradesh', 'Jharkhand', 'Karnataka', 'Kerala', 'Madhya Pradesh', 'Maharashtra', 'Manipur', 'Meghalaya', 'Mizoram', 'Nagaland', 'Odisha', 'Punjab', 'Rajasthan', 'Sikkim', 'Tamil Nadu', 'Telangana', 'Tripura', 'Uttar Pradesh', 'Uttarakhand', 'West Bengal', 'Delhi', 'Chandigarh', 'Puducherry', 'Jammu And Kashmir', 'Ladakh') AND b.state_norm <> pin.pin_state
UNION ALL SELECT 'One doctor but 30 or more specialties', name, city, state_norm, facility_type, concat(cast(size(spec_arr) AS string), ' specialties') FROM base WHERE doctors = 1 AND size(spec_arr) >= 30
UNION ALL SELECT 'Same name and city as another record', b.name, b.city, b.state_norm, b.facility_type, 'duplicate' FROM base b JOIN dup ON lower(trim(b.name)) = dup.k_name AND lower(trim(b.city)) = dup.k_city

datasets.name: ds_keywords
queryLines:
WITH k AS (SELECT explode(array(
  named_struct('kw', 'dialysis', 're', '(?i)dialysis'),
  named_struct('kw', 'NICU / neonatal', 're', '(?i)nicu|neonatal'),
  named_struct('kw', 'MRI', 're', '(?i)\\bmri\\b|magnetic resonance'),
  named_struct('kw', 'C-section', 're', '(?i)c-section|cesarean|caesarean|lscs'),
  named_struct('kw', 'cardiac surgery', 're', '(?i)cardiac surg|cardiothoracic|bypass|cabg|open heart'),
  named_struct('kw', 'burn care', 're', '(?i)\\bburns?\\b'),
  named_struct('kw', 'trauma', 're', '(?i)trauma'),
  named_struct('kw', 'ICU', 're', '(?i)\\bicu\\b|intensive care'),
  named_struct('kw', 'CT scan', 're', '(?i)\\bct\\b|computed tomography'),
  named_struct('kw', 'ventilator', 're', '(?i)ventilator'),
  named_struct('kw', 'blood bank', 're', '(?i)blood bank'),
  named_struct('kw', 'cancer / oncology', 're', '(?i)oncolog|cancer|chemotherap'),
  named_struct('kw', 'emergency', 're', '(?i)emergency'),
  named_struct('kw', 'ambulance', 're', '(?i)ambulance'))) AS p)
SELECT p.kw AS keyword,
  sum(CASE WHEN concat_ws(' ', specialties, procedure, equipment, capability, description) RLIKE p.re THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_field,
  sum(CASE WHEN specialties RLIKE p.re THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_specialties,
  sum(CASE WHEN procedure RLIKE p.re THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_procedure,
  sum(CASE WHEN equipment RLIKE p.re THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_equipment,
  sum(CASE WHEN capability RLIKE p.re THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_capability,
  sum(CASE WHEN description RLIKE p.re THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_description,
  sum(CASE WHEN (coalesce(cast(specialties RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(procedure RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(equipment RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(capability RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(description RLIKE p.re AS int), 0)) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_one_field_only,
  sum(CASE WHEN (coalesce(cast(specialties RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(procedure RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(equipment RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(capability RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(description RLIKE p.re AS int), 0)) >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_three_or_more_fields
FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities CROSS JOIN k
WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.kw

datasets.name: ds_kwstrength
queryLines:
WITH k AS (SELECT explode(array(
  named_struct('kw', 'dialysis', 're', '(?i)dialysis'),
  named_struct('kw', 'NICU / neonatal', 're', '(?i)nicu|neonatal'),
  named_struct('kw', 'MRI', 're', '(?i)\\bmri\\b|magnetic resonance'),
  named_struct('kw', 'C-section', 're', '(?i)c-section|cesarean|caesarean|lscs'),
  named_struct('kw', 'cardiac surgery', 're', '(?i)cardiac surg|cardiothoracic|bypass|cabg|open heart'),
  named_struct('kw', 'burn care', 're', '(?i)\\bburns?\\b'),
  named_struct('kw', 'trauma', 're', '(?i)trauma'),
  named_struct('kw', 'ICU', 're', '(?i)\\bicu\\b|intensive care'),
  named_struct('kw', 'CT scan', 're', '(?i)\\bct\\b|computed tomography'),
  named_struct('kw', 'ventilator', 're', '(?i)ventilator'),
  named_struct('kw', 'blood bank', 're', '(?i)blood bank'),
  named_struct('kw', 'cancer / oncology', 're', '(?i)oncolog|cancer|chemotherap'),
  named_struct('kw', 'emergency', 're', '(?i)emergency'),
  named_struct('kw', 'ambulance', 're', '(?i)ambulance'))) AS p),
m AS (
  SELECT p.kw AS keyword,
    coalesce(cast(specialties RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(procedure RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(equipment RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(capability RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) + coalesce(cast(description RLIKE p.re AS int), 0) AS n_fields
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities CROSS JOIN k WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT keyword,
  CASE WHEN n_fields = 1 THEN '1 field (weak)' WHEN n_fields = 2 THEN '2 fields' ELSE '3 or more fields (strong)' END AS evidence,
  count(*) AS facilities
FROM m WHERE n_fields >= 1
GROUP BY 1, 2

  named_struct('kw', 'emergency', 're', '(?i)emergency'),

f AS (

)
SELECT f.state AS state, k.p.kw AS keyword, count(*) AS facilities_in_state,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.txt RLIKE k.p.re THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS facilities_mentioning,
  round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN f.txt RLIKE k.p.re THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct_mentioning
FROM f CROSS JOIN k
WHERE f.state IN ('Andhra Pradesh', 'Arunachal Pradesh', 'Assam', 'Bihar', 'Chhattisgarh', 'Goa', 'Gujarat', 'Haryana', 'Himachal Pradesh', 'Jharkhand', 'Karnataka', 'Kerala', 'Madhya Pradesh', 'Maharashtra', 'Manipur', 'Meghalaya', 'Mizoram', 'Nagaland', 'Odisha', 'Punjab', 'Rajasthan', 'Sikkim', 'Tamil Nadu', 'Telangana', 'Tripura', 'Uttar Pradesh', 'Uttarakhand', 'West Bengal', 'Delhi', 'Chandigarh', 'Puducherry', 'Jammu And Kashmir', 'Ladakh')
GROUP BY f.state, k.p.kw
HAVING count(*) >= 100

datasets.name: ds_specialties
queryLines:
SELECT specialty, count(*) AS facilities
FROM (SELECT explode(array_distinct(transform(from_json(specialties, 'array<string>'), x -> x))) AS specialty FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL)
WHERE specialty IS NOT NULL AND specialty <> ''
GROUP BY specialty
ORDER BY facilities DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_equipment
queryLines:
SELECT item, count(*) AS facilities
FROM (SELECT explode(array_distinct(transform(from_json(equipment, 'array<string>'), x -> lower(trim(x))))) AS item FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL)
WHERE item IS NOT NULL AND item <> ''
GROUP BY item
ORDER BY facilities DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_procedures
queryLines:
SELECT item, count(*) AS facilities
FROM (SELECT explode(array_distinct(transform(from_json(procedure, 'array<string>'), x -> lower(trim(x))))) AS item FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL)
WHERE item IS NOT NULL AND item <> ''
GROUP BY item
ORDER BY facilities DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_domains
queryLines:
SELECT domain, count(*) AS facilities
FROM (SELECT explode(array_distinct(transform(from_json(source_urls, 'array<string>'), x -> lower(regexp_extract(x, '^(?:https?://)?(?:www\\.)?([^/]+)', 1))))) AS domain FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL)
WHERE domain IS NOT NULL AND domain <> ''
GROUP BY domain
ORDER BY facilities DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_bytype
queryLines:
SELECT CASE WHEN facilityTypeId IN ('hospital', 'clinic', 'dentist', 'doctor') THEN facilityTypeId ELSE 'other or unknown' END AS facility_type,
  count(*) AS facilities,
  round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN try_cast(capacity AS double) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct_with_beds,
  round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN try_cast(numberDoctors AS double) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct_with_doctors,
  round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN try_cast(yearEstablished AS double) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct_with_year,
  round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN length(equipment) > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct_with_equipment,
  round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN length(procedure) > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct_with_procedure,
  percentile_approx(try_cast(capacity AS double), 0.5) AS median_beds,
  percentile_approx(try_cast(numberDoctors AS double), 0.5) AS median_doctors
FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities
WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: ds_quality
queryLines:
SELECT count(*) AS total_rows,
  sum(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usable_rows,
  count(*) - count(DISTINCT unique_id) AS duplicate_unique_ids,
  sum(CASE WHEN latitude IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_without_coordinates,
  sum(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND NOT (latitude BETWEEN 6 AND 37 AND longitude BETWEEN 68 AND 98) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coordinates_outside_india,
  sum(CASE WHEN size(from_json(source_ids, 'array<string>')) >= 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_20plus_sources,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN size(from_json(source_ids, 'array<string>')) >= 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct_with_20plus_sources
FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities

datasets.name: ds_district
queryLines:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT try_cast(regexp_replace(address_zipOrPostcode, '[^0-9]', '') AS bigint) AS pin
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.facilities WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL
), p AS (
  SELECT pincode, max(initcap(lower(trim(district)))) AS district, max(initcap(lower(trim(statename)))) AS state
  FROM databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset.india_post_pincode_directory GROUP BY pincode
)
SELECT coalesce(p.district, '(PIN not matched)') AS district, coalesce(p.state, '(PIN not matched)') AS state, count(*) AS facilities
FROM f LEFT JOIN p ON f.pin = p.pincode
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY facilities DESC

datasets.name: ds_lv
queryLines:
SELECT facility_id, name, facility_type, operator_type, city, district, state, latitude, longitude,
  care_level, coalesce(concat('Rung ', care_level), 'No rung') AS rung,
  care_level_label, level_kind, level_basis, level_confidence,
  coalesce(newborn_level, 'None listed') AS newborn_level,
  coalesce(obstetric_level, 'None listed') AS obstetric_level,
  coalesce(trauma_level, 'None listed') AS trauma_level,
  coalesce(dialysis_level, 'None listed') AS dialysis_level,
  CASE WHEN nabh_claimed THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS nabh_claimed,
  CASE WHEN pmjay_claimed THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS pmjay_claimed,
  level_reason, quality_score,
  coalesce(x.level_check, 'no outside record') AS outside_check,
  coalesce(x.external_evidence, '') AS outside_evidence
FROM workspace.vf_gold.facility_level LEFT JOIN workspace.vf_gold.facility_external_check x USING (facility_id, care_level, operator_type)

datasets.name: ds_lv_sum
queryLines:
SELECT
  count(*) AS facilities,
  count_if(care_level IS NOT NULL) AS with_rung,
  count_if(level_confidence = 'high') AS high_conf,
  count_if(care_level = 5) AS rung5,
  count_if(obstetric_level LIKE 'CEmONC%') AS cemonc,
  count_if(newborn_level LIKE 'NICU%') AS nicu,
  (SELECT count_if(level_check = 'confirms') FROM workspace.vf_gold.facility_external_check) AS confirmed_outside
FROM workspace.vf_gold.facility_level

datasets.name: ds_lv_state
queryLines:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT state, coalesce(concat('Rung ', care_level), 'No rung') AS rung, count(*) AS n
  FROM workspace.vf_gold.facility_level WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT state, rung, n, round(100.0 * n / sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY state), 1) AS pct
FROM s WHERE state IN (SELECT state FROM workspace.vf_gold.facility_level GROUP BY state HAVING count(*) >= 100)

# Facility Field Explorer
An eye test of the Virtue Foundation facilities table before you build on it. Everything runs live against `databricks_virtue_foundation_dataset_dais_2026.virtue_foundation_dataset`.

**How to read it:** every field was scraped from the web, so treat each value as a claim. Charts on every page except *Field completeness* leave out rows with no coordinates, which are mostly broken imports. Use the pages at the top to move between completeness, size and outliers, record trust, and service claims.

lines:
## Can you trust a record?
Each row was stitched together from several web sources. The more sources a row has, the more likely it mixes in claims from other facilities. This is the merged-record problem the challenge warns about. Source lists stop at 50 items, so 50 means "50 or more".

When this was built, records with 1 to 5 sources claimed about 14 specialties on average, and records at the 50-source cap claimed about 49 out of a possible 50. A record that claims every specialty is telling you about its sources, not about the facility.

lines:
# Care levels
Every facility is placed on India's five-rung referral ladder: **1** sub-centre, **2** PHC or clinic, **3** CHC or nursing home, **4** district hospital or multispecialty hospital, **5** medical college or super-specialty hospital. Diagnostic centres and pharmacies get no rung.

**How it is decided:** the name when it states a public tier ("District Hospital", "PHC", "Medical College"), otherwise beds plus the services the record lists (ICU, CT, dialysis, blood bank for rung 4; neurosurgery, cath lab, MRI, NICU, transplant, radiotherapy for rung 5). **Confidence** is high when the name, a teaching affiliation, or beds plus services agree; low when only the facility type is known. These are inferences from scraped claims, not official designations. Source: `workspace.vf_gold.facility_level`. Outside check: `workspace.vf_gold.facility_external_check` (OpenStreetMap, Oct 2026; government lists once uploaded via notebook 05).
